question: Book international fiat currencies ke kaun-se examples deti hai?
essence: USD, EUR, JPY, GBP aur CNY examples hain; symbol ke saath currency code bhi padhein.
answer: Book USD ko globally most widely held aur traded fiat currency batati hai; EUR ke liye 27 EU members mein se 20 ka adoption deti hai. JPY stability aur global currency markets mein role ke liye, GBP apni purani lineage ke liye, aur CNY global trade aur international reserves mein badhte influence ke liye diya hai. Yeh supplied book ke claims hain, live update nahi. [p004]
deep_dive: EUR ka 'second-most' caption incomplete hai, isliye ranking complete nahi ki gayi. GBP ko book oldest fiat currency still in use kehti hai aur lineage 8th century tak le jaati hai; lineage ko 8th century se fiat status ka proof na samjhein. ¥ symbol JPY aur CNY dono ke liye diya hai, isliye codes distinction saaf karte hain. [p004]
